title: Hearty Portuguese Chicken Stew
description: A spicy, gooey Portuguese chicken stew cooked in a clay pot, featuring lime leaves and a low FODMAP-friendly sauce.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a clay pot over medium‑high heat until it shimmers.
Add the chicken thighs and brown them on all sides until golden brown.
Sprinkle 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1 tsp sea salt, and 1/4 tsp black pepper over the chicken and stir well.
Pour in 1 diced large tomato and 1 diced red bell pepper, stirring until the vegetables begin to soften.
Add 10 fresh lime leaves and 1 cup low FODMAP chicken broth, then bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the clay pot, and let the stew cook for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
After the chicken is tender, stir in 1/4 cup coconut milk and simmer uncovered for an additional 10 minutes until the sauce thickens and becomes gooey.
Taste the stew and adjust the seasoning with extra salt or pepper if desired.
Serve the stew hot straight from the clay pot, ensuring each serving is generous with sauce.
